verification_policy: A feature is registered only when its implementation path was inspected. Live-provider, staging, and production status are separate from source presence.
audit_notes: Phase 24 expands the registry additively; prior records are preserved for compatibility.
IMPLEMENTED_AND_CONNECTED means source-side contracts are connected and covered by local evidence; it does not certify live providers, staging, or production.
React local/mock state, Flask HTML/API routes, Firebase identity, Flask AI, and Express AI are intentionally preserved overlaps until an approved consolidation is completed.

features.name: Flask authentication and OTP
features.source: Existing Flask implementation; preserved Copilot-preferred OTP flow
features.integration_status: implemented-local-contract; staging-provider-blocked
features.ownership: Flask server-side identity and OTP authority
preservation_requirements: Do not duplicate or replace OTP verification.
Keep session cookies, CSRF, hashing, expiry, cooldown, and attempt limits.

features.name: React catalog, cart, and wishlist bridge
features.source: Google AI Studio-style React UI with additive Flask adapter
features.integration_status: implemented-by-source-and-tests; browser-staging-blocked
features.ownership: Flask catalog, stock, session cart, and customer ownership
preservation_requirements: Never trust client price, stock, seller, or role values.

features.name: Customer COD checkout, orders, returns, and notifications
features.source: Existing NexHaat Flask commerce plus additive React integration
features.integration_status: implemented-contract; authenticated-browser-and-provider-not-tested
features.ownership: Flask transaction, pricing, inventory, payment, and order authority
preservation_requirements: Online payment and refund callbacks remain server-authoritative.

features.name: Scoped AI marketplace assistants
features.source: Existing Stage 12 Flask AI Core plus Express Gemini UI service
features.integration_status: source-and-local-tests-present; live-provider-blocked
features.ownership: Flask AI scopes/tools for marketplace authority; Express for auxiliary Gemini/science capabilities
preservation_requirements: AI output cannot authorize payment, role, inventory, order, or admin actions.
Keep human confirmation for consequential mutations.

features.name: Android marketplace client
features.integration_status: source-compatible-and-unit-tested; live-device-not-tested
features.ownership: Android client consumes Flask versioned API
preservation_requirements: Preserve response envelope, cookie jar, CSRF interceptor, and BuildConfig base URL.

features.name: Database backup and restore tooling
features.source: Existing Flask CLI and service implementation
features.integration_status: local-backup-integrity-passed; disposable-restore-blocked
preservation_requirements: Never restore over an active or production target without approved isolation.
Keep explicit target confirmation and integrity validation.

features.name: Customer marketplace shell and discovery journey
features.auth_requirements: Public browsing; customer session for protected mutations.
features.integration_status: Flask server-rendered path is connected; React retains guest/local fallback and browser staging is unverified.
overlaps: React presentation and Flask/Jinja marketplace routes
missing_or_incomplete: Live React-to-Flask session, CSRF, and CORS behavior requires staging verification.

features.name: Catalog, categories, filtering, and search
features.auth_requirements: Public read; seller/admin authorization for catalog mutations.
features.integration_status: Backend/API and local tests present; some React filtering remains client-side and live search latency/provider behavior is unverified.
overlaps: Server-side catalog search and React local filtering

features.name: Product details, media, reviews, and trust signals
features.auth_requirements: Public product read; authenticated customer for review creation; seller/admin moderation authorization.
features.integration_status: Flask/API and review tests are present; complete React detail-to-review live flow is not verified.
overlaps: Product detail data in React context and server catalog response
missing_or_incomplete: Live media storage and browser delivery are not verified.

features.name: Cart and wishlist
features.auth_requirements: Customer session and ownership checks; guest preview is non-authoritative.
features.integration_status: Server contract and React mutation bridge exist; authenticated browser hydration and concurrency are unverified.
overlaps: React local cart state and server cart authority

features.name: Checkout, pricing, payment, refunds, and ledger
features.auth_requirements: Authenticated customer ownership; server-authoritative totals, stock, payment state, and admin refund permissions.
features.integration_status: Server-side checkout/payment invariants and tests exist; provider credentials, webhook replay, and live payment are unverified.
overlaps: React checkout preview and Flask transaction authority
missing_or_incomplete: Live provider callback and reconciliation evidence.

features.name: Orders, fulfillment state, returns, and delivery
features.auth_requirements: Customer ownership; seller fulfillment scope; admin/rider transition permissions.
features.integration_status: Server state machine and tests are present; live customer/seller/rider workflow is unverified.
overlaps: Jinja order routes and React order views
missing_or_incomplete: No staging evidence for end-to-end status transitions.

features.name: Customer profile, addresses, and account settings
features.auth_requirements: Authenticated customer ownership and CSRF/session protection.
features.integration_status: Flask/Jinja and API implementation are present; no verified React profile page integration was found.
overlaps: Flask account pages and API account contract
missing_or_incomplete: React customer profile surface is not verified.

features.name: Admin, operations, moderation, and audit portal
features.auth_requirements: Explicit admin permissions, CSRF, audit records, and deny-by-default resource scope.
features.integration_status: Flask admin surface and security tests exist; React admin UI is not proven connected to all privileged endpoints.
overlaps: React admin dashboard and Flask/Jinja admin portal

features.name: Notifications, support, and customer communication

features.integration_status: API, outbox, and local tests exist; external delivery providers and retry operations are not live-verified.
overlaps: React notification view and Flask notification API
missing_or_incomplete: Delivery observability and provider outage behavior require staging evidence.

features.name: Flask scoped marketplace AI
features.auth_requirements: Role-scoped permissions, rate limits, guardrails, and human confirmation for consequential actions.
features.integration_status: Flask AI contracts, tools, guardrails, and local tests are connected; external model availability is unverified.
overlaps: Express Gemini assistant is a separate auxiliary capability
missing_or_incomplete: Provider latency/cost and adversarial prompt evaluation require authorized environment evidence.

features.name: Express/Gemini and science AI services
features.auth_requirements: Server-side provider keys and endpoint controls; no claim of Flask identity equivalence.
features.integration_status: Express routes and client callers exist; live Gemini/provider credentials and deployment behavior are unverified.
missing_or_incomplete: Broad CORS and large JSON limit require separate security hardening review.
No verified provider health, cost budget, or rate-limit evidence.

features.name: Versioned Flask APIs and domain services

features.integration_status: Blueprint registration, service boundaries, clients, and broad local test coverage are present; live cross-client deployment is unverified.
overlaps: Server-rendered Flask routes expose overlapping business journeys
missing_or_incomplete: External staging, CORS/session, and production telemetry are not verified.

features.name: Android marketplace application

features.integration_status: Source adapters, CLI operations, and local tests exist; live Telegram, mail, scheduler/worker, and restore environments are unverified.
